claim: Single-parameter degree-aware L2 scaling closes the measured 6.8pp tail-degree shift deficit over a tuned 2-layer GCN baseline without added encoders or auxiliary losses.
simplest_alternative: Tuned 2-layer GCN baseline (0 extra modules) scoring 0.718 macro-F1 across 5 seeds.
ablation_evidence: Adding only degree_aware_l2_scaling raises macro-F1 from 0.718 to 0.752 (+0.034 across 5 seeds).
